hints: You need the middle of a growing collection. What would you have to be able to see, at any moment, to name it immediately?
The largest of the smaller half and the smallest of the larger half. Those are the roots of a max-heap and a min-heap.
Keep the two halves' sizes within one of each other. Then the median is one root, or the average of both.
Adding is two steps: push onto the side the reading belongs to, then move one element across if the sizes drifted apart.
